I further certify and attest that I have affixed hereto recent photographs of the
executants to the protocol of the deed and that stamp duty to the value a sum of
Rupees One Hundred and Ninety One Thousand Seven Hundred and Eighty
(Rs.191,780/=) was duly deposited in cash in the Bank of Ceylon Battaramulla branch
in proof of which the original of such stamp duty paying in slip No. BC/SE/OP
No.296912 dated 18/07/2025 for Rs.191,780/= is affixed to the duplicate of this
instrument and, copies are affixed to the original and the protocol and the Original of
this instrument bears one stamp of Re.1/= and that the said stamp was supplied by
me.
And I have applied for the renewal of the license for the current year.
Date of Attestation
18th July 2025.
WHICH I ATTEST
Notary Public.
W.W.ANURA
